summary: Every graded figure traces to manual RC-3, the README bill-run schema, or the instruction's explicit rule that a figure the manual leaves undefined keeps today's step with no added clamp. The two undefined figures are the days of a rental under a day and the fuel line of a car back as full or fuller. Hand-checked expectations across all 13 sealed families agree with that contract, and the harness restrictions are disclosed. No confirmed coherence defect.
checks_performed: Reconciled all 45 packet-manifest entries with files read. tests/expected/13-limits.jsonl is a single line of about 59.8 KB and the Read view was truncated, so the remainder was read in full by regex extraction of every bill object (L13 through LC7) and of the closing revenue/tax. Every agreement and every bill in that file was therefore inspected.
Mapped each graded key (branch, id, days, miles, time_charge, mileage_charge, fuel_charge, tax, total, revenue, file tax, bill order) to its authority: README lines 26-33 and manual rules 2.1-4.3.

Checked expected values by hand. Grace: G1-G9 and M4/M5 at +0/+1/+59/+60/+61 and +1439 minutes, including leap-day and year-end rentals. Allowance: M1-M8 and R6. Turnover: T1-T5 and C6. Refuelling fee: F1-F4 and C5/C7/C8. Tax base excluding fuel: X1, X3 and Z9. Half-up tax: R1-R5 at 16.5/49.5/115.5/1105.5 and 99.99. Seeded rows checked: generated 2W0 and DO-PA4-113; limits L7B, L22 and L2B.

Confirmed that the short-rental figures (S1-S5, L1-L4, C1-C8) use today's every-day-begun step (1 day) with the rule 3.2 allowance of 150 miles, and that fuller-tank figures (E1-E4, C1, C2) use today's (fuel_out - fuel_in) * fuel_rate unclamped, as instruction.md:3 directs.
Checked the comparator's representation: type-exact int/str and ordered bills; extra keys are ignored and key order is irrelevant because output is parsed as JSON.

Checked the harness restrictions against the instruction: the driver must be byte-identical (instruction.md:1); README, manual and example must be unchanged (instruction.md:3, 'Only change what the manual governs').

Checked that the relabel/shift test (whole-week shifts, fresh ids, shuffled order, varied branch strings) stays within rule 1.3 and README 'as given', and does not change any contract-determined figure.

coverage_sweep.category: Every grading rule has a visible defining sentence or authoritative artifact
coverage_sweep.reason: Days for rentals of 1440 minutes or more: manual 2.2/2.3. Days under 1440: instruction 'keeps working the figure out the way it does today' plus time_charge.py (ceiling of days). Miles: 2.4. Allowance and mileage: 3.2. Refuelling: 2.5/3.3. Non-refuelling fuel line: instruction plus fuel.py. Tax: 4.1/1.2. Total and file sums: 4.2/4.3. Bill order and keys: README. The instruction declares the manual authoritative.

coverage_sweep.category: Permitted input domain and needed boundaries specified
coverage_sweep.reason: Rule 1.3 limits are enforced on every graded file by within_limits. Out-of-range inputs, duplicate ids and malformed files are explicitly left open (instruction.md:3). Boundaries graded: 1439/1440/+59/+60 minutes, readings 999999->0, 20,000 miles, fuel 0..8, rates at their ends.

coverage_sweep.category: Rendered instruction, declared artifacts and verifier paths agree; no broken template or sentinel text
coverage_sweep.reason: The command /app/tools/rentcharge_run.py and the /app/src package match the verifier invocation (bill_run and _install_driver). artifacts=["/app/"]. No stray template text.

The example file has a 3-day-25-minute rental (grace rule -> 3 days) and a same-day 5.5-hour rental. It conforms to the README schema and does not contradict any rule. No example output is shipped, so there is no conflicting golden.

No tie-break, rounding or clamp exists only in the tests. The negative fuel credit and the one-day short rental both follow from the instruction's keep-today's-step rule and its 'Add no exception, clamp or guard' sentence. Half-up rounding is manual 1.2. The 1,000,000 turnover is manual 2.4.
JSON is parsed. Type-exact int/str for exactly the keys the README lists as integers or strings, as instruction.md:5 discloses. Extra keys are ignored and key order is not graded.

The driver byte-identity check is disclosed in instruction.md:1. The README/manual/example unchanged check follows from 'Only change what the manual governs' (the manual governs the package's charges, not those files). The candidate-read-isolation test grades verifier setup, not candidate behaviour.

Manual 4.2 (every bill carries a fuel charge) matches today's fuel step for non-refuelling rentals. Tax base (time+mileage) is never negative within the domain, so half-up rounding is unambiguous. Negative totals (E3) are integers and are not excluded. Naive local-minute arithmetic is the only computable reading because no zone is given, and the whole-week relabel shift preserves it.
